methods.label: Factor the repeated expression
methods.explanation:
Both terms contain \(2x+3\), so factoring out this repeated expression turns the equation into a product:
\[
(2x+3)\bigl((x-4)+(x-6)\bigr)
=(2x+3)(2x-10)=0.
\]
A product is zero exactly when at least one factor is zero. Thus all the roots come from
\[
2x+3=0\quad\text{or}\quad 2x-10=0,
\]
which give \(x=-\frac32\) and \(x=5\). Their sum is
\[
-\frac32+5=\frac72.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{\frac72}\), choice A.
